purpose: Watch a championship; teach リーグ/女子/統計/勝利/予測/唯一/チャンス/復活

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いよいよリーグ優勝がかかった試合だね。
lines.en: Finally, a match with the league title on the line.
lines.style: hyped fan leaning into the big game

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今シーズン、女子チームの快進撃がすごい。
lines.en: This season the women’s team’s run is incredible.
lines.style: impressed fan praising the squad, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 統計を見ると、得点力が一番高いんだ。
lines.en: By the statistics, their scoring is the highest.
lines.style: data-savvy fan citing the numbers, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 専門家は、どっちの勝利を予測してるの？
lines.en: Which side’s victory do the experts predict?
lines.style: curious newcomer asking eagerly, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 接戦になるって予測が多いよ。
lines.en: Most predictions say it’ll be close.
lines.style: fan summarizing the consensus, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あのエースが、唯一の得点源だからね。
lines.en: That ace is their sole scoring source.
lines.style: fan highlighting the key player, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今がチャンス！ 攻めてる！
lines.style: excited newcomer caught up in the play

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 去年最下位からの復活、感動的だね。
lines.en: A comeback from last place last year — moving.
lines.style: moved fan appreciating the arc, voice clear and distinctly their own
